name: studywise
description: STUDYWISE. En KI-basert studieassistent for høyere utdanning med integrasjon mot Canvas Instructure. Bachelor i IT 2026.

scripts.kill:dev: npx kill-port 3000 4000 2>nul & taskkill //F //IM node.exe 2>nul & rimraf frontend\.next\dev\lock && echo Servere stoppet og lock-fil ryddet
scripts.build: pnpm --filter common build && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.build:frontend: pnpm --filter common build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.build:backend: pnpm --filter common build && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.clean:install: echo Cleaning backend... && npx rimraf backend/node_modules backend/dist && echo Cleaning frontend... && npx rimraf frontend/node_modules frontend/.next && echo Cleaning common... && npx rimraf common/node_modules common/dist && echo Cleaning root... && npx rimraf node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml && echo Installing dependencies... && pnpm install && echo Building project... && pnpm run build
